name: Vuk Is Reborn
summary: If no one stops the ritual, Vuk returns in Fasha's body and begins to take the lakes.
segments: The cult completes the vessel and Fasha begins to change.
Vuk's followers gather at the temple and the old rites resume.
Vuk takes the lakes and Isthmus Town empties or bends the knee.
advance_on: the White Tower ritual is completed
the temple rite reaches its final stage
effects: Vuk's cult becomes the power in the region.
Isthmus Town is deserted or conquered.
The Tideborn and the Order of Nine respond to the new threat.

name: The Gate Opens
summary: If Annafranax's ritual is not stopped, the Gate under Deadmill opens and the Roots spill into the region.
segments: The water in East Lake turns black and the mill race slows.
The Deadmill grove begins to sink.
A sinkhole opens, and creatures from the Roots come through.
effects: Isthmus Town becomes a military outpost and refuge.
The Cities send soldiers and scholars to the new frontier.
